content.short: Arbitrum is an Ethereum Layer 2 scaling solution with low fees and reduced congestion, enabling smart contracts and Dapps.
content.description: Arbitrum is an Ethereum Layer 2 scaling solution that supports smart contracts without the limitations of scalability and privacy. Users enjoy low transaction fees and less congestion on Arbitrum. Developers can deploy smart contracts by coding for a virtual machine (VM) that implements the contract’s functionality, enabling more scalable and private contract execution. Additionally, developers can use Arbitrum for dramatic improvements in scalability and privacy.
content.meta: Arbitrum is a low-cost Ethereum Layer 2 solution for building secure Dapps. Discover Arbitrum and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
